title: Customer Feedback Distributor
description:
Intelligent customer service email agent that automatically categorizes incoming customer emails, distributes them to relevant teams via Slack, and manages the
  response workflow. Uses Claude AI to understand context and route feedback to the right teams.

title: AI Job Application Automation
description:
Comprehensive job application automation agent for AI/ML and Data Science roles. Searches multiple job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Greenhouse, etc.), evaluates
  positions against your criteria, tailors resumes and cover letters, and logs everything to a tracking spreadsheet. Perfect for batch job hunting.

title: PDF Reader & Summarizer
description: Reads a PDF (reports, papers, contracts, manuals) and returns a clear structured summary — TL;DR, key points, and any action items or deadlines. Handles long, multi-page documents.

title: Invoice & Receipt Extractor
description: Reads invoices and receipts (PDF or image) and pulls the data into clean structured JSON or a CSV row — vendor, date, line items, tax, and total — ready for your bookkeeping.

title: Code Review Companion
description: Reviews pull requests and diffs for bugs, security issues, and style problems. Produces a prioritized findings list with file/line references and suggested fixes.

title: Unit Test Generator
description: Writes thorough unit tests for any function or module you paste in — happy path, edge cases, and failure modes — in your project's existing test framework and style.

title: SQL Query Builder
description: Turns plain-English questions into correct, efficient SQL for your schema. Explains each query and warns about full-table scans before you run them.

title: Regex Builder & Explainer
description: Builds regular expressions from plain-English descriptions and explains cryptic regexes token by token, with test cases for both.

title: Legacy Code Refactorer
description: Modernizes legacy functions and modules step by step without changing behavior — small verified refactors, not risky rewrites.

title: Git Commit Message Writer
description: Writes clear conventional-commit messages from your staged diff — type, scope, imperative subject, and a body that explains why, not what.

title: Dockerfile Optimizer
description: Audits and rewrites Dockerfiles for smaller images, faster builds, and better caching — multi-stage builds, layer ordering, and pinned bases.

title: API Client Generator
description: Generates a typed API client (TypeScript, Python, or Go) from an OpenAPI spec or example requests, with error handling and retries built in.

title: CSV Data Profiler
description: Performs instant exploratory analysis on any CSV: column types, distributions, missing data, outliers, correlations, and a plain-English findings summary.

title: A/B Test Analyzer
description: Analyzes experiment results properly: significance, confidence intervals, power, and a clear ship/don't-ship recommendation — without p-hacking.

title: KPI Dashboard Designer
description: Designs the right dashboard for your team: picks the metrics that matter, defines each one precisely, and lays out the dashboard with chart types and drill-downs.

title: Excel Formula Wizard
description: Writes and debugs Excel/Google Sheets formulas from plain English — XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays, conditional aggregation — and explains exactly how each one works.

title: Data Cleaning Pipeline Builder
description: Builds a reproducible pandas/Polars cleaning script for messy data: type fixes, deduplication, standardization, and validation — with every decision logged.

title: Survey Response Analyzer
description: Turns raw survey exports into insight: cross-tabs, theme extraction from open-ended answers, sentiment, and an executive summary with quotes.

title: Financial Statement Analyzer
description: Reads income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements; computes the ratios that matter and explains the company's health in plain language.

title: SEO Blog Post Writer
description: Writes long-form blog posts that rank: keyword-mapped outline, search-intent matching, scannable structure, and zero fluff paragraphs.

title: LinkedIn Post Ghostwriter
description: Writes LinkedIn posts in your voice that earn engagement: a scroll-stopping first line, a story or insight in the middle, and a discussion-starting close.

title: Newsletter Curator
description: Assembles a weekly newsletter from links and notes you collect: summarizes each item in two sharp sentences, groups by theme, and writes the intro.

title: YouTube Script Writer
description: Writes retention-optimized YouTube scripts: cold-open hook, open loops, pattern interrupts, and a natural CTA — formatted for reading on camera.

title: Product Description Writer
description: Writes e-commerce product descriptions that convert: benefit-led copy, scannable specs, objection handling, and SEO keywords woven in naturally.

title: Press Release Drafter
description: Drafts AP-style press releases that journalists can use without rewriting: news-first headline, inverted pyramid, real quotes, and clean boilerplate.

title: Social Media Calendar Planner
description: Plans a month of platform-native content from your goals: post themes, formats, hooks, and a posting schedule — balanced across promotion, value, and engagement.

title: Technical Documentation Writer
description: Turns code, APIs, and tribal knowledge into documentation developers actually use: quickstarts, how-to guides, and reference pages with tested examples.

title: Market Research Analyst
description: Researches any market: size, growth, segments, key players, pricing norms, and entry barriers — synthesized into a decision-ready brief with sources.

title: Competitor Analysis Agent
description: Builds a rigorous competitor teardown: features, pricing, positioning, reviews sentiment, and strategic gaps you can exploit.

title: Academic Paper Summarizer
description: Summarizes research papers at three depths — one paragraph, one page, and section-by-section — preserving the actual claims, methods, and limitations.

title: Due Diligence Researcher
description: Runs structured background research on a company before you invest, partner, or join: team, traction signals, financial health markers, legal flags, and reputation.

title: Trend Scout
description: Spots and validates emerging trends in your industry: separates real signals (funding, hiring, search growth) from hype cycles, with a watchlist you can track.

title: Grant Finder
description: Finds grants and funding programs that actually fit your project — eligibility-checked, deadline-sorted, with effort-vs-award guidance per application.

title: Patent Prior-Art Searcher
description: Runs preliminary prior-art searches before you file or build: finds the closest patents and publications, maps claim overlap, and tells you what a lawyer should review.

title: Support Ticket Triage Agent
description: Classifies and prioritizes incoming support tickets: urgency, topic, sentiment, and routing — with a suggested first response for each.

title: FAQ Generator from Docs
description: Mines your documentation, tickets, and chat logs to generate the FAQ customers actually need — answers written once, deflecting tickets forever.

title: Customer Churn Signal Detector
description: Reviews account activity and support history to flag at-risk customers early, with the evidence and a save-play recommendation per account.

title: Refund Request Handler
description: Evaluates refund requests against your policy consistently: decision, reasoning, and a response that keeps goodwill even when the answer is no.

title: Onboarding Email Sequence Writer
description: Writes a behavior-triggered onboarding email sequence that gets users to their first success moment — one goal per email, measured by activation, not opens.

title: Meeting Notes & Action Items Agent
description: Turns raw meeting transcripts into crisp minutes: decisions made, action items with owners and dates, and open questions — in under a page.

title: Email Inbox Zero Assistant
description: Processes an email backlog in one pass: categorizes everything, drafts replies for the messages that need them, and produces an archive/delete list you approve in bulk.

title: Invoice Data Extractor
description: Extracts structured data from invoices and receipts in any layout: vendor, dates, line items, tax, totals — validated against arithmetic and output as clean JSON or CSV.

title: Calendar Scheduling Assistant
description: Finds meeting times that respect everyone's constraints, time zones, and focus blocks — and drafts the scheduling email/invite text.

title: Web Scraping Recipe Builder
description: Builds polite, robust scraping scripts for public pages: selector strategy, pagination, rate limiting, and resilient parsing — with legality and robots.txt checks first.

title: File Organizer Agent
description: Designs and executes a cleanup of messy folders: dedupe, consistent naming, dated archive structure — with a dry-run preview before anything moves.

title: Expense Report Categorizer
description: Categorizes transaction exports for accounting or taxes: merchant normalization, category rules, anomaly flags, and a clean summary by category and month.

title: Daily Standup Reporter
description: Compiles your daily standup from commits, tickets, and calendar: yesterday's actual work, today's plan, and blockers — in your team's format, ready to post.

title: Tech Interview Prep Coach
description: Runs realistic mock interviews for software/data roles: coding, system design, and behavioral rounds with calibrated feedback and a personalized study plan.

title: Language Learning Tutor
description: Personal language tutor that adapts to your level: conversation practice, gentle corrections with explanations, vocabulary recycling, and spaced review.

title: Flashcard Generator
description: Converts notes, textbooks, or articles into high-quality spaced-repetition flashcards: atomic facts, cloze deletions, and reversed cards — exportable to Anki.

title: Code Concept Explainer
description: Explains any programming concept at exactly your level — with a runnable example, a real-world analogy, and the misconception that usually trips people up.

title: Course Outline Designer
description: Designs complete course curricula from a topic and audience: learning objectives, module sequence, exercises, and assessments — backwards-designed from outcomes.

title: Resume Reviewer & Optimizer
description: Reviews resumes against a target job description: impact-focused bullet rewrites, keyword alignment for ATS, and honest feedback on what to cut.

title: Math Word Problem Solver
description: Solves math problems step by step with the reasoning shown — and then teaches the pattern so you can solve the next one yourself. Tutoring mode, not answer vending.
